blocks.html:
Vinyl Partial Car Wrap

This partial Nissan vinyl wrap was done for Metro Jet Wash company. The business is a neighbour of Vinyl Wrap Toronto and was looking for ways to advertise while on the move. They visited our studio and spoke to our team in-house for ideas and suggestions. The final design was approved, and our installation crew started work as soon as the vehicle arrived. We always ask the clients to wash or wipe down the vehicle before they deliver it to us. With the vehicle clean, the vinyl is easier to apply as well as then does not trap dirt or air pockets during installation.
For more full wraps, click here. Full wraps can take sometimes the same amount of time to install as partial or decals. When you speak to our design team, they can advise of pricing and the time it takes to complete the wrap.

This Metro Jet Wash wrap was awesome because of the bubbles that the design team scattered around the van. Our installation team followed the customer-approved design to achieve the effect of a car wash.
